brief:
Israeli forces fired on a woman with a disability at Qalandia checkpoint in Jerusalem governorate, the Ma'an news agency reported. Her condition following the shooting was unclear.

The incident took place at one of the West Bank's main crossing points. Qalandia checkpoint, which connects Israeli-controlled and Palestinian-administered areas, has repeatedly been the site of armed clashes between Palestinians and Israeli military forces.
title: Woman with disability shot at Qalandia checkpoint
